finalText:
Fixed it. Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise.

`resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on every build. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it threw too.

Both now handle the new shapes. Build exits clean: 0 errors, just the expected 8 deprecation warnings from the bump itself.
